content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a critical infrastructure problem: payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves creators unable to sell their digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—to a global audience. The solution is not a workaround but a sovereign commerce stack. This guide shows you how to deploy [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-4|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-step-step-deployment-8|supabase]] as your order database, integrated with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-6|NOWPayments Integration]]. You’ll own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Just a fully operational digital store that accepts crypto payments from anywhere.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is built on open, decentralized tools that no single entity controls. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free, with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, ensuring low-latency responses. Supabase, a PostgreSQL-based database, stores order data securely and scalably. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic on-chain verification. Together, these tools form a sovereign commerce stack that operates independently of restricted payment platforms. You’re not renting infrastructure—you’re owning it. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities, not hypotheticals.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, ensure you have a clear inventory of digital products to sell. Prepare product descriptions, pricing in your preferred cryptocurrencies, and delivery files (ebooks, templates, etc.). Set up a Cloudflare account for Pages and Workers, and a Supabase account for your database. Register for NOWPayments to configure your payment gateway. If you’re deploying Stack 02, COREMERCH will handle the integration and testing for you within 48 hours. For Stack 01, follow the Sovereign Blueprint, which takes 4-6 hours to deploy. Both stacks require no ongoing fees—you pay once and own the infrastructure permanently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept payments in low-fee cryptocurrencies like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Set up webhooks to trigger order fulfillment once payment is confirmed on-chain. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and deliver your digital products securely. For Stack 02, Supabase will store order data, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic to verify payments and trigger deliveries. If you’re deploying Stack 01, Google Sheets will serve as your order database, with Google Apps Script managing backend processes. Both stacks ensure automatic, instant product delivery without manual intervention.
Supabase and Cloudflare Workers form the backbone of a store that no platform can shut down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, depending on your stack. Test the entire pipeline on a testnet before going live. Send a test payment to ensure the webhook triggers order fulfillment correctly. Once confirmed, promote your store to your audience. For Stack 02, COREMERCH will end-to-end test the infrastructure before handoff, ensuring everything works seamlessly. Monitor your Supabase dashboard for incoming orders and use Cloudflare’s analytics to track storefront performance. Your first live transaction marks the beginning of infrastructure sovereignty—no platform can shut you down.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your stack deployed, focus on scaling your store. Add more products to your inventory and optimize your storefront for conversions. Use Supabase’s real-time capabilities to build features like live order tracking or customer dashboards. Leverage Cloudflare’s edge network to ensure fast, global access to your store. If you’re on Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration for professional communication. As your store grows, upgrade to more advanced tools within the COREMERCH ecosystem, but the core infrastructure remains yours—unchanged and unrentable.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, deploy Stack 01 using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Google Sheets for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification at a 0.5% fee. This stack is free to deploy and operates without subscriptions. For a more robust solution, Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours for $197. Both stacks give you full data ownership and infrastructure sovereignty.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee and automatic on-chain verification ensure you get paid without intermediaries.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy a digital store without relying on restricted platforms, start with the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both stacks are designed for creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose your stack. The Edge Commerce Stack includes end-to-end testing and 30-day support, ensuring your store is fully operational from day one.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register for Cloudflare and Supabase accounts. Prepare your digital products and pricing in preferred cryptocurrencies. Configure NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Set up Supabase as your order database or use Google Sheets for Stack 01. Integrate backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test the payment and delivery pipeline on a testnet. Promote your store to your audience. Monitor orders and analytics through Supabase and Cloudflare dashboards. Scale by adding more products and optimizing your storefront.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I deploy this stack if I have no coding experience?
Yes. Stack 01 is designed for non-technical users and can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, requiring no coding from you.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but these networks ensure minimal costs for your buyers.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees for this infrastructure?
No. Both stacks are one-time payments. You own the infrastructure permanently, with no subscriptions or hidden fees.
How secure is my customer data in Supabase?
Supabase is a PostgreSQL-based database with built-in security features. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, ensuring compliance with global standards.
Can I upgrade from Stack 01 to Stack 02 later?
Yes. Your data and products can be migrated seamlessly. COREMERCH provides blueprints and support for upgrading your infrastructure as your store grows.
Deploy once, own forever—no subscriptions, no platform lock-in, just sovereign infrastructure.
